correctness.rationale: Exact Euclidean barycentric Gram formula and maximal-coordinate homothetic cap yield independent Dirichlet boundary shape Q and exact radial distribution. Monotonicity plus strict threshold proves valid inversion without overlooking the outer simplex. Lagrange inversion supplies convergent positive coefficients; exact Dirichlet factorial moments give rational coefficients and independent sampling confirms the low dimensional formulas. All dimensional and all epsilon quantifiers are proved analytically.

value.rationale: Worst-case Euclidean vertex quantization and the scarcity of points near its unique deep hole are natural geometric statistics. The theorem gives an exact all-dimensional endpoint law, rigorously convergent rational corrections, and a sharp Weibull scaling limit for sample maxima, none supplied by only a centroid radius or a second moment. This is a complete, motivated near-extremal classification.
